request: If edge with bigger radius is considered as top, add supporting structure to the bottom of the frame by offseting inner wall by 2cm with thickness of 0,5cm of the supporting structure all around. This will create step at the bottom of the frame, enlarging bottom surface area. Leave out radii at the bottom edges. Add radii from top, 0,2cm which will create smoothe transition from above. Bottom remains flat.

actions.operation: Create an all-around supporting structure that forms a step at the bottom of the frame by offsetting the inner wall.
actions.target: The inner wall and bottom of the existing frame.
actions.relational_constraint: Use the edge having the bigger existing radius to establish the top orientation. Place the supporting structure at the bottom and continue it all around the inner-wall contour.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the edge with the bigger radius, the resulting top and bottom orientation, and the inner-wall contour. The offset direction and the vertical extent of the supporting structure are not explicitly stated and must be resolved from the model or clarified.

actions.operation: Omit fillets or other radii from the bottom edges, leaving those edges unrounded.
actions.target: The bottom edges of the frame and newly created supporting step, as applicable.
actions.relational_constraint: Only bottom edges are to remain without radii.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the complete set of edges considered bottom edges after creation of the supporting structure.

actions.operation: Add fillet radii to the top-side edges of the supporting structure or step.
actions.target: The top-side transition edges associated with the newly created supporting structure.
actions.relational_constraint: Apply the radii from the top to produce a smooth transition from above; do not apply them to the bottom edges.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the exact top-side edges that form the transition between the original frame and the supporting structure.

actions.target: The bottom face of the frame and supporting structure.
actions.relational_constraint: The bottom must remain flat and must not be altered by the top fillets.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the final bottom face or coplanar set of bottom faces after the supporting structure is created.

intention: Provide additional support at the bottom of the frame.
Enlarge the bottom surface area of the frame.
Create a smooth transition when approached from above while retaining a flat bottom.
